title: HALOFLUX Orca state v1
description: Read-only snapshot from orca worktree ps. Poll every 1.8 seconds when active, without overlap; timeout after 6 seconds. Errors clear workspaces and set connected=false. Pausing or stopping cancels the child and suppresses callbacks until resumed or restarted. All timestamps are Unix milliseconds; null means no source value. Counts are derived from the actual agents array, never CLI terminal counts.

activeWorkspaceId.description: ID of the first workspace whose source isActive is true; never inferred from cwd or recency.

error.description: Bounded error code only; no raw stderr or error message content.

status.description: Unmapped source status; fallback workspaceStatus or unknown.

id.description: workspaceId/paneKey; nested observed subagents append /subagent:<source id>.

parentId.description: workspaceId/parentPaneKey, or containing pane's ID for an observed subagent.

modelId.description: Trimmed, single-line identifier from this exact source agent or subagent's model field. For a main pane with no usable model, optional read-only Orca hook metadata must match workspace ID, pane key and client type; the latest receivedAt wins and tied latest records remain null. Hook payload.model is accepted only for Stop/PermissionRequest with matching agentPresence.session and providerSession.id and no child-agent markers. Codex fallback requires the hook's exact providerSession.id and transcriptPath to match threads.id and rollout_path in that transcript's permitted account home/state_5.sqlite. Rollout content is never read. A 10-second cache with database/WAL file signatures bounds reads. No model is inferred from agentType, another agent, or global settings. Missing, empty, oversized or control-bearing values, and unresolved auto/automatic/default/unknown/unspecified selectors, remain null.

modelDisplayName.description: The same verified source identifier as modelId, preserving its version without inventing a marketing name. Null when the source does not expose a model.

title.description: taskTitle, displayName or conversationName. Subagent description is used only if already a single line of at most 100 characters; otherwise type plus short ID. No prompts, tool inputs, terminal output or assistant messages are included.

state.description: Unmapped mainAgent.state when provided, otherwise source agent state. Subagents preserve their own state.

needsInput.$comment: Observed Codex child async requests additionally require the same account's threads and thread_spawn_edges to reach the current root session (at most 16 ancestors). The child's source parent and rollout-header parent must agree with its immediate spawn edge; its own header ID must match the observed child ID. Each pane/session is scanned independently.
needsInput.description: True only for a current user request associated with an exact local workspace/pane/client/session and live PTY. Blocking requests require a waiting/blocked root plus an explicit root interactivePrompt shape or matching request event; a child request is attributed only to its exact observed child ID. Codex asynchronous request_user_input_async calls with valid question structure are projected from the exact session rollout, independently of working/done. Reads begin with an 8 MiB tail, incrementally follow appended records and backfill older 1 MiB sections until a human/interrupt boundary or file start; each poll has a 16 MiB aggregate budget. Inode, truncation and session changes reset the cursor; no old pending state is published before catching up to the current file tip. Human-delivered user source metadata or interruption clears requests; agent notices, environment context, compaction, immediate accepted tool results, and normal turn completion do not. Metadata is processed on the existing utility queue; text and tool arguments are never retained or passed to the web scene. False means no confirmed request, including unsupported, oversized or unreadable metadata; ordinary waiting, unread, idle and child joins never independently trigger this flag.

attentionReason.description: The confirmed request kind, or null when needsInput is false. Approval takes priority if a blocking approval and an asynchronous question coexist.

outcome.description: Whitelisted mainAgent.outcome, or subagent.outcome when explicitly present. These are Orca's AGENT_TURN_OUTCOMES. Missing and unknown future values remain null; done without an outcome does not prove successful completion.

interrupted.description: Original interrupted flag, only when explicitly supplied as a boolean. Missing remains null.

updatedAt.description: Original update timestamp; a child's startedAt is never substituted.

stateStartedAt.description: Original state-transition clock, or null. Legacy child startedAt describes its birth and is never used here.

hasLivePty.description: True only when the source explicitly reports a live PTY; child agents without this field use false.

activity.description: Optional original pane activity metadata, restricted to known status fields. Its potentially message-bearing title is excluded.
